Superflash Jacket.name: Superflash Jacket
Superflash Jacket.description: A nice jacket carrying a surpise; using an action anyone wearing this jacket can consume a battery to let off a blinding light. Treat as a Flashbang Grenade without the Damaged Ear Critical Injury, centered on the wearer.

Chipware Compartment.name: Chipware Compartment
Chipware Compartment.description: Lets you conceal up to four pieces of chipware, no Check required. Retrieval is done by spending an action to spin the eye in its socket.

Smart Lens.name: Smart Lens
Smart Lens.description: Gives a user a single Cybereye Option. Can use one Smart Lens per eye.

MicroCutie.name: MicroCutie
MicroCutie.description:
Using an action the user can enable HypurrburstTM mode. HypurrburstTM mode increases the weapons damage to 4d6, but drains all remaining shots when fired. Requires at least 4 rounds remaining to enable. The weapon purrs while in HypurrburstTM mode*.
Special fire mode not currently supported; will need to be manually applied
